text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Whew... alright.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, it's gradually starting to move just the way I want it to!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, I can dig into the ground with all my strength.
Every single stride is so much more powerful than before...!
Now, if my sensations just click into place perfectly...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(—I... feel like I can run
even more amazingly...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Nishino Flower returned,
she had a look on her face as if she had grasped something.
choice_data_list: You don't seem all that fatigued.
You don't seem all that fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I wonder if this is also
proof that I'm growing bigger—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Zephyr-san!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It's still not enough.
At this rate, I won't even come close."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Zephyr-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
Yamanin Zephyr seemed to have a faint shadow over her.
choice_data_list: If you're worried, just come talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure that's okay?
I might just get in your way...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"What if I'm just being
meddlesome...?"
choice_data_list: It's up to her whether she wants to talk about it or not.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Right. Whenever they need someone to listen, I'm sure they'll talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um! On the way back, could you
wait for me just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san!
Um—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Into the wind...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I cannot reach the wind I long for.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Zephyr-san, do you happen to have
someone you look up to?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Does that surprise you...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm...
That was a little unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san looks at things differently...
Um, it's like she's competing with herself, in a way...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However...
it all began with a mighty gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sheer force of that wind swept me up...
and guided me all the way to this place.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yet even that wind
was not completely free.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—The limit.
The wall known as the 2000m distance...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I will.
I'll take in even that wind, and challenge the wall.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"There are no walls; I resolved to blow straight through...
all the way to the endless beyond. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Fighting against yourself
is truly a difficult thing."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (For the sake of the precious person she admires... She's just like me right now.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Unable to run properly... It was a very positive step, but hitting that wall... Back then, I...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...'I want to do my best for their sake,
but I'm scared... of what if I can't do anything?' Is that it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
It seems... I may be feeling fear.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I can't achieve my ideal run in the next Yasuda Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Flower-san.
Your kindness is so comforting...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, I... all I could do
was listen to her story.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, I've received other things from you as well.
Watching you run inspires me...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you at the next race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...Zephyr-san looked really troubled about something."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is there really nothing I can do...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, how?
choice_data_list: You're up against a wall right now too.
You're also up against a wall right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is a different hurdle from Yamanin Zephyr,
with her sprint and mile aptitudes, taking on medium distances.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower had been working hard to show a new side of herself, running better than ever before.
choice_data_list: If I can show them me overcoming this wall...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... just maybe I can
give Zephyr-san some courage!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I've decided!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen... I'll do my absolute, very, very best!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you to be crushed by the feeling of giving your all for someone else.
Because that's...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because it makes me super happy,
and it's such a wonderful thing……!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I will definitely win the Yasuda Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower showed a determination to win at all costs for the first time.
All so she could convey those feelings to Yamanin Zephyr!
